objective: Audit cross-platform pathname namespace collisions in the portable release manifest before clean-machine handoff: case-insensitive aliases, Windows reserved device names and trailing-space/dot canonicalization, and whether the current canonical POSIX path invariant can describe payloads that are valid on Linux but ambiguous or unmaterializable on a supported Windows host.
nonduplicate_boundary: Excludes symlink/junction confinement, archive extraction, mutable-root TOCTOU, and crash consistency; focuses solely on pathname namespace representability/collision across supported host filesystems.
